records.name: Scheduled castle siege
records.participants: Two declared teams; neutral civilians stay outside combat flags
records.objective: Breach designated defenses and control the objective through a held window
records.authority: Match/territory aggregate owns teams, flags, score, objective revisions and settlement
records.respawn: Protected rally points, team wave timers, spawn-exit invulnerability until attack or expiry
records.supply: Finite ammunition and repair stock; supply route has at least two approaches
records.control_policy: Shared hard-control ledger, capped displacement and no spawn-volume damage
records.destructibles: Whitelisted authored stages only; nav safety test before collision swap
records.neutral_rules: A separate opt-in contract previews PvP flag, cargo risk and reward; otherwise neutral cannot be damaged
records.territory_rewards: Time-limited cosmetic administration, optional services and declared fees under a baseline service floor
records.reconstruction: Essential routes restored at deadline; ownership of homes, quests and personal goods unaffected
records.disconnect: Short reconnect reservation; unattended actor follows published safe despawn policy, never grants duplicate score
anti_grief: No forced flag by friendly healing or area reactions
acceptance_tests: Nonparticipant crosses a protected route unharmed
All objectives remain reachable after every allowed destruction state
Disconnect and duplicate objective messages cannot double score
Two teams cannot deny the third all safe exits
Every result restores services without population dependence
